title: The Fingerprint Reserve
description: Open weights can't be locked, so ownership is proven by counting surviving fingerprints. Embed thousands of secret key-response pairs; an adversary fine-tunes to scrub them and each audit burns one to leakage. Watch the reserve survive — or not.
